component: EC100 Brayton Cycle Gas Turbine (Simple Cycle)
description: GT efficiency with quadratic PLR correction and ISO 2314 ambient temperature/pressure corrections

unit.name: GE 7F.04 class simple-cycle GT (185 MW ISO)
unit.source: Walsh & Fletcher (2004), Gas Turbine Performance; ISO 2314:2009; GE Power F-class data

eta_rated.note: Net thermal efficiency at ISO (ambient 15C, 101.325 kPa)

plr_c.note: PLR curve: f=a+b*PLR+c*PLR^2; at PLR=1: f=1.0; steeper drop at low load vs combined cycle

T_exhaust_iso_k.note: Exhaust temperature at ISO full load (~580 degC)

T_exh_partload_rise_k.note: Exhaust T rise at 0% load vs full load

LHV_gas_mj_kg.note: Lower heating value of natural gas
